_comment: UI anchors scripts/canvas-browser.mjs depends on. Microsoft changes Studio, the player and the maker portal
without notice; when the driver stops finding something, this is the one place to fix it.
Check them against a live tenant with: node scripts/canvas-browser.mjs doctor  (exit 0 all resolve, 9 stale).
The same defaults are compiled into the driver; an entry here overrides the field it names.
kind: css | role (role + name pattern) | text (pattern) | regex (pattern) | template ({placeholders}) | attribute | anyOf (list of css/role/text).
check: required = doctor must find it in a normal session; conditional = appears only in a state doctor does not create.
lastVerified: the skill version or ISO date at which the entry was last seen working; doctor --record writes the date.

portal.makerHome.purpose: Maker portal entry point used by login and check

portal.makerUrl.purpose: Identifies the Studio tab among open pages

portal.signedInUrl.purpose: URL the maker portal lands on once sign-in has completed

portal.signInUrl.purpose: A redirect to sign-in means the saved profile has expired

portal.signInInput.purpose: The account-name box of the sign-in page

portal.playerUrl.purpose: Published app URL (overridden by playerUrl in canvas-app.json)

portal.studioUrl.purpose: Opens the app in Studio in edit mode

player.controlAttribute.purpose: Attribute every rendered canvas control carries; finds the app frame and names controls in sweeps

player.consentAllow.name: ^allow$
player.consentAllow.purpose: Connection consent prompt shown after clearing storage

player.staleBanner.purpose: Banner shown when the player runs a cached build

player.staleRefresh.name: ^refresh$
player.staleRefresh.purpose: The stale banner's own Refresh button

studio.titleEditing.purpose: Window title marker: this session holds the edit lock

studio.titleReadOnly.purpose: Window title marker: an edit lock is held elsewhere

studio.authoringFrameUrl.purpose: URL of the iframe that holds the Studio editor

studio.saveFlyout.purpose: Chevron that opens the Save flyout (never the Save button itself)

studio.savedStamp.purpose: The 'Saved: <time>' line in the Save flyout - the proof a save landed

studio.publishConfirm.purpose: Confirm button in the publish dialog (doctor never publishes, so never exercises it)

studio.closePreview.purpose: Present only while Studio is in Preview

studio.leaveButton.purpose: Leave confirmation shown by Back when there is unsaved work

studio.backButton.purpose: Leaves the editor and releases the edit lock

studio.gotIt.purpose: Dismisses first-run and teaching bubbles that swallow command-bar clicks

portal.newAppUrl.purpose: Opens Studio on a new blank app in a solution (what the portal's New > App > Canvas app dialog opens)

portal.appIdInUrl.purpose: The new app's id, which appears in Studio's URL after the first save

studio.appSettings.name: ^app settings$
studio.appSettings.purpose: Opens the Settings dialog from the left rail

studio.appLayout.name: ^app layout$
studio.appLayout.purpose: Responsive or Fixed (formerly Scale to fit)

studio.listOption.purpose: Options of an open Settings dropdown (they carry no accessible name; matched by text)

studio.coauthoringSwitch.name: ^coauthoring$
studio.coauthoringSwitch.purpose: Off on a new app; the authoring server needs it on

studio.saveRefreshUpdate.purpose: Confirms 'Save and refresh' after the Coauthoring switch (the dialog is aria-hidden, so no role query)

studio.dataSearch.name: ^search$
studio.dataSearch.purpose: Add data search; matches display names only

studio.dataItemDescription.purpose: Part of each Add data result's accessible description that names its logical table

studio.dataSourceAdded.pattern: data source was successfully added|was added to your app
studio.dataSourceAdded.purpose: Confirmation that a data source was added

studio.welcomeSkip.purpose: Dismisses the welcome dialog a new app or fresh profile opens on (its overlay blocks every click)

studio.modernSwitch.name: ^modern controls and themes$
studio.modernSwitch.purpose: Modern controls (create --modern); off on a new app in some tenants

studio.welcomeDontShow.purpose: 'Don't show me this again' on the welcome dialog (it returns after every refresh otherwise)

studio.canvasRoute.purpose: A Studio editor tab (not the portal's app list or a player tab); tabs, tidy and close-studio use it

studio.editUrl.purpose: A Studio URL that opens an existing app; second-tab never reuses a new-blank URL (it would create another app)

studio.formulaBar.name: formula
studio.formulaBar.purpose: The formula bar of the selected property (dirty)

studio.formulaEditor.purpose: The formula bar's editable surface (dirty clicks here, then types)

browser.blankUrl.purpose: Blank, new-tab and crashed pages that tidy closes

player.dropdownOption.purpose: An option of an open classic DropDown (a button plus a listbox, not a select); the walk's pick verb

consent.confirmUrl.purpose: The connector consent service's confirm step; reaching it completes an OAuth connection (the connection command)

consent.accountTile.purpose: The configured account's tile on the Entra account picker, when sign-in is not silent
